messages:
maria.finance: Quick one 1   - customer asked for an invoice reversal. AMP credits applied mid-April, they want a rebill in May. Do we treat as a revenue reduction now or a deferred credit? @sam.revrec @alex.billing

sam.revrec: If the credit was applied at invoice time and customer requested reversal before cash collection, we should remove revenue for April. But operational cutoff matters. Need exact invoice date & reversal request date.

alex.billing: Invoice 2024-04122: usage $12,000, AMP promo -$7,500, net $4,500. Invoice date 2024-04-22. Customer asked for reversal 2024-04-30 via support ticket INC-4622. They want a reissue on 2024-05-05.

maria.finance: Thanks. Is the AMP considered contra-revenue per contract? Joe?

joe.salesops: Yes, clause 4.1 states promo/AMPs are applied as billing credits (contra) not marketing expense. So revrec should reflect as reduction of gross usage revenue.

sam.revrec: Practical approach for April close: book JE to move the credit to a deferred liability until re-bill. JE: Debit Revenue 7,500; Credit Deferred Credits 7,500. This preserves revenue through period-end controlled by a liability until rebill in May.

alex.billing: Operationally we'll also create a reversing AR/Credit memo to offset the original invoice and a new invoice in May. But for close we need the JE and supporting memo.

liz.finance_lead: Approved to post JE > $5k. Please add reference to INC-4622 and include contract clause. Add to close package.

maria.finance: I'll add to the close checklist and attach screenshots. Billing, please confirm GL accounts: 4001 Usage Rev, 2305 Deferred Credits.

alex.billing: Confirmed. I'll create ticket INC-4623 for the JE and link the credit memo. billing-bot: /create-ticket INC-4623 JE draft (https://ops.internal/inc/4623)

sam.revrec: Flag for policy review: we should standardize treatment for mid-period promo reversals (contra-rev vs marketing). Add to May RevRec policy agenda.

maria.finance: Noted. For now JE posted before final close. Closing loop: JE approved, tickets created, rebill scheduled for 2024-05-05.
notes: Short Slack-style thread about AMP credit reversal and April close treatment; includes ticket IDs and GL guidance.
